title: Eviction-induced quant accuracy regression: detection, rollback playbook, and long-term mitigations
creator: Maya Patel
description: Summary: During a capacity spike in a Dedicated pool we observed a sustained accuracy regression on a quantized 13B model variant. The regression correlated with aggressive KV cache eviction activity and subsequent kernel selection fallbacks in the quantized execution path. This ticket captures the immediate rollback/playbook steps taken, a detailed timeline, the root cause hypothesis validated by post-incident traces, and a prioritized action list to prevent recurrence.
impact_summary: Customer-facing latency increases and generation quality regressions for ~6% of traffic routed to quantized-13B variants over a 2.5 hour window. Two enterprise customers reported degraded quality and opened support tickets; no data exfiltration or integrity failures were detected.
timeline: 2026-03-01T02:13Z: First alert - automated canary accuracy monitor triggered (drift > 3% relative to baseline)
2026-03-01T02:20Z: Ops increased logging and enabled per-request kernel trace for affected nodes
2026-03-01T02:27Z: We observed correlated spike in KV cache evictions and background weight rehydration events on GPU pool A
2026-03-01T02:35Z: Multiple instances reported fallback to software dequant path and mixed kernel usage; latency rose 2.2x for impacted requests
2026-03-01T03:00Z: Incident declared P0 and rollback to full-precision hosted variant initiated for affected routes
2026-03-01T03:18Z: Rollback complete; canary and customer-reported quality returned to baseline within 10 minutes
2026-03-01T04:00Z: Post-incident trace analysis started; initial hypothesis formed (eviction -> incomplete op fingerprint -> fallback mismatch)
2026-03-01T10:00Z: Cross-team incident review with Runtime, Platform, and Evals; action items captured
root_cause: Intermittent KV cache evictions during a capacity pressure event caused partial operator state reinitialization. The quantized runtime encountered operator opset/shape permutations it had not exercised since model load (e.g., fused attention with variable key-lengths) which triggered a permissive fallback path that used a different dequantization ordering. The fallback produced subtle numerical differences that, for a subset of prompt shapes, pushed model outputs outside canary thresholds. The canary eval set did not include sufficient examples of these prompt shape permutations, so drift was detected later than ideal.
action_items: Immediate (owner: Luca) - Build and deploy emergency routing rule to divert affected routes from quant-13B to fp-13B until a canary passes (ETA: 1h) - status: done
Immediate (owner: Maya) - Add high-cardinality metric 'quant.op_fallback_rate' and alert when >0.5% sustained for 5m (ETA: 12h) - status: in progress
Short term (owner: Runtime team) - Implement eviction-aware checkpointing to ensure operator state persists across cache thrashing (ETA: 2 sprints) - estimate: 8
Short term (owner: Evals) - Expand canary evaluation set to include variable-length key/query distributions, fused-op permutations, and real traffic shadow samples (ETA: 1 sprint) - estimate: 5
Short term (owner: Platform) - Harden autoscaler eviction policy to prefer lower-priority workloads over inference pools during sudden capacity pressure (ETA: 3 weeks) - estimate: 13

Medium term (owner: Runtime/Infra) - Add a runtime 'strict-opset' flag for rollout that fails fast on opset mismatch instead of silently falling back; use for canaries and staged rollouts (ETA: 3 sprints) - estimate: 8

Medium term (owner: QA) - Create regression harness that replays sampled real requests with quantized variants and verifies token-level distributions, not just high-level metrics (ETA: 4 weeks) - estimate: 8
Long term (owner: Research) - Publish an operator-compatibility matrix per model family and quant profile; integrate into model onboarding checklist (ETA: Q3) - estimate: 13
Operational (owner: SRE) - Add an automated canary that can shadow 1% of production traffic to quantized variants for at least 15 minutes before rollout (ETA: 2 sprints) - estimate: 8
risks_and_open_questions: How many other model variants are susceptible to the same eviction->opset mismatch pattern? (action: audit model catalog)
Will strict-opset fail-fast mode increase outages if misapplied on models with heterogeneous opsets? (action: define safe rollout defaults)
What is the additional latency/cost of permanent eviction-aware checkpointing? (action: perf budget evaluation)
Can we synthesize representative prompt shapes for canaries automatically from customer workloads without violating privacy? (action: privacy review)

Public status: No public incident page required; customer-facing advisory drafted (Confluence link above)
owner_notes: Prioritization rationale: regression affects output quality and enterprise SLAs -> P0. Rolling back to FP variant is a safe short-term mitigation. Long-term fixes must balance latency/cost gains from quantization against the risk surface introduced by permissive fallback logic.
